item.name: Main plot / Lemon Stand
item.cardSummary: The main plot is the route anchor. It teaches the cash loop and gives you the first place to check after buying stand upgrades or decorations.
item.connectedSystem: Lemon Stand, first upgrades, cash drops, decoration gates, early automation
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Lemon Stand, Juicer, Cup Stand, Cash Register Automator, decoration purchases
item.rewardOrReason: Sets up the first income loop and reveals early buttons that can be missed if decoration gates are ignored.
item.travelNote: Treat the plot as the route anchor before moving to LemonDash, Depot, or later teleport arrows.

item.name: Lemon Depot / Trading edge
item.cardSummary: The Depot and Trading edge is the first major route split. Use it when the starter stand is no longer enough and you need wholesale or market income.
item.unlock: After the early stand and delivery route
item.connectedSystem: Lemon Depot, wholesale selling, Depot manager, Trading Post
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Depot station, multiplier panel, Depot manager, Trading Post entrance
item.rewardOrReason: Moves the run from starter clicking into wholesale income and the first major mid-game route split.
item.travelNote: Check inside and around the Depot after buying building pieces because new useful buttons may appear away from the previous purchase.

item.name: Hill Expansion
item.cardSummary: Hill Expansion turns the map into a climb. Each new layer can reveal later systems, so scan the new level before rushing away.
item.unlock: Unlocked after Depot and Trading progress
item.connectedSystem: Hill layers, Labs entrance, Robotics route, Republic route
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Layer unlock buttons, hill buildings, summit route, Labs and Robotics entrance
item.rewardOrReason: Opens the vertical late-game build path and the route toward the strongest normal progression systems.
item.travelNote: Treat the hill as a layered climb. Buy each layer, then walk the new level for hidden or newly revealed buttons.

item.name: Sewer Maze
item.cardSummary: The Sewer Maze is the first hidden route. It matters because levers, doors, and the Cosmic Vine path start the secret-key chain.
item.unlock: Enter from main-street manholes; Sewer Key route unlocks the Cosmic Vine gate
item.connectedSystem: Sewer Key, colored lever puzzle, Cosmic Cash Vine, Cosmic Farmer reward path
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Manholes, colored levers, colored doors, Sewer Key, Cosmic Cash Vine
item.rewardOrReason: Gives access to secret key progression and the Cosmic Vine path without turning the location card into a full puzzle walkthrough.
item.travelNote: Finish a key route before leaving because lever progress can reset. Use a fresh server between key routes if the levers behave strangely.

item.name: UFO / Alien route
item.cardSummary: The UFO and alien route is a secret endgame branch. It connects Sewer progress to Good Samaritan, the UFO Key, and later LemonX preparation.
item.unlock: Requires rebirth and investor progress before the UFO Key route can be completed
item.connectedSystem: UFO Key, alien NPC quest, Good Samaritan reward, investor bonus
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: UFO Key, Homeless Alien or alien NPC, sewer levers, investor requirement
item.rewardOrReason: Connects the sewer puzzle chain to the permanent Good Samaritan investor bonus and later endgame preparation.
item.travelNote: Start from the sewer route, talk to the alien NPC at the required step, and keep Moon or LemonX context tied to this route unless the game sends you to a separate area.

item.name: First Tier Staircase
item.cardSummary: First Tier Staircase is a permanent endgame route near Republic progress. Save it for very late runs where staircase purchases are affordable.
item.unlock: About 1 trevigintillion cash near the Republic area, plus very late investor progress
item.connectedSystem: First Tier, spiral staircase, Ascension prerequisite, permanent progression
item.keyObjectsOrNpcs: First Tier button, spiral staircase, stairway purchase buttons
item.rewardOrReason: Adds a permanent stairway route that persists through Rebirth and Evolution and points toward Ascension.
item.travelNote: Look near the Republic area after reaching trevigintillion-scale progress. Buy the staircase buttons along the way before expecting the Ascension path to be complete.
